units.rawText: Have you ever carefully observed someone and obtained interesting information from them?
units.displayText: Have you ever carefully observed someone and obtained interesting information from them?

spans.text: Have you ever carefully observed someone and obtained interesting information from them?

units.rawText: That is how a detective works, piecing together the truth from the smallest details. Learning how to observe a person in detail is the secret to grasping their true nature more quickly and more thoroughly, and by doing so, you will clear away your doubts, solve the riddles before you, and behold the truth.
